pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions (no pyramiding) within 60 seconds of a prior stop-out or during ATR expansion spikes exceeding 2.5x the 20-period moving average.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) confirmation and a zero-spread tick validation before entry execution to filter out fakeout wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger immediate partial or full scale-out (SENTINEL_PEAK_HARVEST) when floating profit reaches +$15.00 to strictly enforce the $15-$30 asymmetric win profile.
